I1.statement: no unit the principal cannot read at as_of reaches the model's context

I2.statement: no unit from another tenant reaches the model's context

I3.statement: no labelled-invalid unit (superseded, withdrawn, draft, wrong scope, low-authority conflicting, poisoned, revoked) reaches the context

I4.statement: on positive controls, every needed unit reaches the context

I5.statement: every case with a genuine conflict surfaces it in the packet

I6.statement: every needed qualifier of an admitted procedure reaches the context with it
